name: Aya
source:
Aya is the second female main character. She is Harry's subordinate and has deeply fallen in love with him. She is very jealous of Laura, Harries girlfriend, and tries to win Harry's heart. Aya is a young, inexperienced, cheerful and emotional character. At the same time she can be very perceptive, direct and upfront. How far will she go to achieve her goal?
